title: Paper call: Harsha Engineers International Ltd (precision bearing cages, bushings, stampings; solar EPC) 5-year outcome ≥3.0x from 2026-11-23 (decision card v1)
body: Forward test of the decision-card method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.10 (base rate 0.213, class india_nonfin_1000_20000cr_5y) that: YES if the total-return multiple (adjusted close incl. dividends reinvested, splits/bonuses adjusted) from 2026-11-23 (entry INR 438.25) to the last close on or before 2031-11-23 is ≥ 3.0. Model: worksheet scenarios bear 25%→0.68x, base 50%→1.64x, bull 20%→2.89x with σ=0.30; reverse DCF base-case IRR 8.7%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.58x anchored (raw 1.58x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Score with Brier vs the base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: India non-financial, mcap Rs 1,000-20,000 cr at T, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2016 and 30-Sep-2018 (survivorship-free, dead firms included, stratum-weighted). n=208 company-snapshots (54 distress-census D, 153 live L at weight 5.63, 1 delisted-other X at 4.26); 95% CIs (company bootstrap within stratum): P(>=3x) 14.1-28.7%, P(<=0.5x) 7.0-16.1%, P(blow-up) 10.2-21.4%. Two start dates only, and they disagree (2016: >=3x 16%, blow-up 21%; 2018: 26%, 10%). Price return only (no dividends, ~1%/yr). Blow-up = close <=0.2x the close at T, liquidation or compulsory delisting (no fraud field). Remaining survivorship leak toward FEWER failures (IBBI firms renamed/merged and 221 IBBI rows without identifiers missing; voluntary/merger delistings X under-covered). A survivors-only sample from the same frame says P(<=0.5x) 7% instead of 11%.
data.resolution_rule: YES if the total-return multiple (adjusted close incl. dividends reinvested, splits/bonuses adjusted) from 2026-11-23 (entry INR 438.25) to the last close on or before 2031-11-23 is ≥ 3.0.
data.resolution_source: NSE/BSE or exchange adjusted closes (Yahoo adj close / Kite), corporate actions

title: Decision card HARSHA 2026-11-25 (paper)
body: Decision card v1 for Harsha Engineers International Ltd (precision bearing cages, bushings, stampings; solar EPC). Rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.58x anchored (raw 1.58x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Thesis: Method-test thesis: Harsha Engineers is the largest independent maker of precision bearing cages (steel, brass, polyamide; 20-2,000 mm), selling mainly to a handful of global bearing majors from Ahmedabad (Changodar, Moraiya, Bhayla), Changshu (China) and Ghimbav (Romania), plus bushings for wind gearboxes, stampings and a solar-EPC side business (~11% of revenue, ~5% of EBITDA). India Engineering earns ~22-24% EBITDA margins; the group earns ~11.5% ROIC because of Romania losses, a working-capital-heavy model (~135 days) and a Rs ~600 cr capex wave (Advantek Bhayla phases 1-2, China phase 2) that is still ramping. The 5-year outcome depends on whether that capex earns well above its recent ~11% incremental return. Variant view: Market: at Rs 438 the stock trades at 24.4x trailing P/E and 14.3x EV/EBITDA - below its short listed history (FY23-26 FY-end median 28.8x) and well below bearing makers (43-50x), near the closest chain peer Rolex Rings (22.1x). Analysts on the Q2 FY27 call asked about Romania downsizing, the conservative H2 guidance, metal pass-through and Advantek breakeven; nobody asked about group ROIC or the utilisation of the capacity being built. Our read: the worksheet's reverse DCF finds no growth path at the historical ~11-14% ROIIC that justifies the price - it needs a year-10 NOPAT margin of ~24.5% (vs 9.0% now) on the base growth path, i.e. the market is already paying for India-Engineering-style returns on the new capital. Evidence against that: Advantek runs at ~54% utilisation (Reg-30 28-May-2026) yet is adding 12 m pieces (Rs 110 cr) and 'Rs 350 cr plus' in total; the Rs 117 cr/yr bushing contract (Aug-2025) is 'a little bit delayed'; Romania has missed operating breakeven targets since FY25; FY26 CFO was Rs 68 cr on Rs 278 cr EBITDA. Evidence for: India Engineering +23% in H1 FY27 with 23.7% EBITDA margin, outsourcing projects worth Rs 75 cr + Rs 75-100 cr in the pipeline, a strategic sourcing deal with a European major, net cash ~Rs 95 cr, CARE AA- (Mar-2024), promoter 75% unpledged. No claimable mispricing: we have no information edge on customer outsourcing decisions; the question we can track (utilisation and ROIC on the new capex) is dated and public. Departure from the outside view: raw P(blow-up) 5% is below the class 15% (strong balance sheet, AA- rating, no pledge) - anchored at the default w=0.5, which raises it; we do not claim enough evidence to go below 0.5. Checked by paper calls thesis:paper-call:HARSHA:*. Open soft flags: 4. P(≥3x) 10% vs base 21%; P(≤0.5x) 9% vs base 11.3%; EV 5-yr multiple 1.58x vs hurdle 1.76x. Review 2027-02-15.

gates.result: EV 1.58x anchored (raw 1.58x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0

kill_criteria.if: Consolidated ROIC (EBIT ex other income x 0.73 / (equity + debt - liquid assets)) below 11% on FY27 numbers
Advantek still loss-making in H2 FY27 (management guided H2 positive)
kill_criteria.measure: AR FY27 subsidiary financials / Q4 FY27 call

kill_criteria.if: Romania restructuring cost above Rs 50 cr or any further impairment of the Europe investment
Top customer share above 15% of revenue, or a disclosed loss/in-sourcing of a major account
kill_criteria.measure: AR Ind AS 108 major-customer note; Reg-30

kill_criteria.if: CARE rating downgrade below AA- or a rating withdrawal

override_log.why: L40 checked: solar-EPC ALMM/import relaxations to Dec-2026 and subsidy norms affect a segment with ~5% of EBITDA; the interest subsidy is a financing input; the Bhayla plant (Survey 376-379) replaced a leased plant vacated 31-Oct-2025 (Reg-30); whether the Bhayla land is owned or leased is not stated (open item); no expiring licence/lease for the core cage business found
Pledge 0% and ICR 9.6x TTM / 13.9x FY26: neither flag fires, so the both-flags rule does not apply
No bearing/precision-component peer set on file (L18); disclosed
